feeds.title: Secrets of Organ Playing Blog
feeds.description: International concert organists, authors, and bloggers Dr. Vidas Pinkevicius and Dr. Ausra Motuzaite-Pinkeviciene are the creators of Secrets of Organ Playing, a blog, podcast, and training site for thousands of organists from 89 countries. They create a daily blogs and podcasts with organ-playing advice and inspiration

feeds.title: Viscount Classical Organs Blog
feeds.description: For 50 years Viscount has been a world leader in electronic classical organs, with first-class engineering at the heart of their makeup. Here at Viscount, we're also very keen to promote the organ (both pipe and digital) and provide learning access opportunities for young people, which is not always easy. We are delighted to have been able to help with a variety of outreach projects and you can read about some of them on our blog.

feeds.title: Joby Bell Organist Blog
feeds.description: Organist Joby Bell is known for 'the breadth of his repertoire, technical virtuosity, and for the personal warmth which shines through in his performances.' His acclaimed blog at Joby Bell Organist deals with a comprehensive range of organ-related topics including teaching philosophies, recital preparation, church music, and professional concerns.

feeds.title: Käthe Wright Kaufman Blog
feeds.description: Käthe Wright Kaufman is the Associate Director of Music and Worship Arts at Glenn Memorial United Methodist Church and Chapel Organist at the Candler School of Theology, both on the campus of Emory University in Atlanta, GA. Read updates and news on Käthe's blog.

feeds.title: James Flores Blog
feeds.description: James Flores is passionate about sharing and preserving the music of the magnificent King of Instruments for generations to come. In the blogs read the latest news and updates regarding the King of Instruments.

feeds.title: Leek Pipe Organs Blog
feeds.description: Organs are complex instruments and can be frustrating when not working properly. We build and restore pipe organs so you can create inspirational services and events for people to enjoy. We offer pipe organ building, repair, restoration, maintenance, tuning, appraisals, education, and historic preservation by experienced professionals providing exemplary service. No matter your pipe organ needs, Leek Pipe Organ Company has you covered.

feeds.title: The Lady Organist
feeds.description: The Lady Organist is written by me, Morwenna Campbell-Smith, and began life in 2013 to inform, educate and entertain both organists and non-organists. This blog began as a record of personal progress, in the hope it might be useful to others doing a similar thing.

feeds.title: Douglas Keilitz Blog
feeds.description: An experienced choral director, Douglas Keilitz has founded several choruses, professional and amateur, and is a former director of the Greater Trenton Choral Society in New Jersey. He is also active as an accompanist and vocal coach and has served in that capacity for several community choruses and synagogues. He is also a composer of choral music, and his works for the synagogue have been performed at New York's Temple Emmanu-El.

feeds.title: American Guild of Organists Blog
feeds.description: The American Guild of Organists (AGO) is the national professional association serving the organ and choral music fields. The mission of the American Guild of Organists is to foster a thriving community of musicians who share their knowledge and inspire passion for the organ. Founded in 1896 as both an educational and service organization, the Guild seeks to set and maintain high musical standards and to promote understanding and appreciation of all aspects of organ and choral music.
